description: Opens or resumes a direct message or multi-person direct message.

channel.description: Resume a conversation by supplying an im or mpim's ID. Or provide the users field instead.

users.description: Comma separated list of user IDs. Creates a 1:1 DM for 1 user, or MPIM for multiple.

return_im.description: Return the full IM channel definition in the response. Default: false.

prevent_creation.description: Do not create a DM or MPIM. Used to check if one exists. Default: false.
